definition: Expected structure of one published result
Normal draw time or times in Philippine Time
IANA timezone used for the schedule
Stable identifier for the lottery game in the historical results snapshot
Draw date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format
Published draw window in Philippine Time
Published jackpot amount when applicable; blank for digit games or unavailable values
Publication status retained from the verified source record
Timestamp when the result record was published or verified
Human-readable name of the public result source
URL for the public source associated with the row
Official source used for final confirmation
LottoLens PH game guide and result reference URL
